source.adopted_pilot_input: Frozen repository Syriac verbatim, compared to the identified CrossWire Peshitta 2.0 public-domain digital reference. Module is NOT an exact-match witness for all eight rows.
source.rights_scope: CrossWire explicitly declares its specific Peshitta module text Public Domain. This does not establish the app historical import lineage or blanket rights for databases, scans, fonts or apparatus. Four recorded semkath-form differences are not concealed as exact matches.
source.attribution: BFBS 1905 Syriac text; digital text courtesy John Richards, distributed by CrossWire Bible Society as Peshitta module 2.0 (2020-02-08). Distribution metadata declares Public Domain. Used as the identified comparator/reference for this pilot, not proof of historical app import.
source.normalization: No edits to frozen source fields. Module one trailing ASCII space retained in extraction evidence; semkath codepoint substitutions retained and individually recorded. NFC does not erase them.

method.description: AI-assisted direct Syriac analysis and proposed target renderings; historical grammar and lexicon assist interpretation, not replace the input. All phrase analyses are proposals, not independent qualified human scholarship.

name_policy.people_places_objects: One explicit personal name; no place name or named relic/object identified in this passage. Light, world, flesh and blood are semantic terms, not objects to blanket-transliterate. No ethnicity/place inserted for his own.

alignments.he_proposed: היה איש אשר נשלח מאת אלהים
alignments.note: Human being plus a passive sending construction. Greek ypirkse is an introduction, not a claim this person was created at that moment. Sent from God is not translated as a claim about physical divine location.

alignments.note: The visible Syriac name is preserved in the source and name registry. Greek Giochanan is a tentative target-script representation, not attested original pronunciation; Hebrew is a letter-correspondence proposal. Greek adds an explicit copula; Hebrew adds a linking waw for readability.

he.text: הוא בא לעדות להעיד על האור למען יאמין כל אדם על ידו׃

alignments.el_proposed: Αυτός ήρθε για μαρτυρία
alignments.note: Purpose/witness proposal. Repository semkath U+0723 differs from module U+0724 here; preserved, not repaired. Greek and Hebrew pronouns reduce the source demonstrative force.

alignments.el_proposed: για να μαρτυρήσει για το φως
alignments.note: Proposed purpose clause rather than a command. A second semkath-form difference is recorded here. Test contemporary Greek fluency without erasing deliberate repetition.

alignments.el_proposed: ώστε κάθε άνθρωπος να πιστέψει μέσω αυτού
alignments.he_proposed: למען יאמין כל אדם על ידו
alignments.note: Purpose, not an assertion all people actually believe. By-his-hand is proposed idiomatically as agency here; Greek does not retain a physical hand noun. Referent of the suffix needs review; do not silently treat the witness as the light or insert a recipient of belief not explicit here.

alignments.note: World rather than age is the proposed contextual rendering of alma. Unexpressed subject/referent needs review after verse 9.

alignments.el_proposed: και ο κόσμος ήρθε στην ύπαρξη με το χέρι του
alignments.note: Same hand/agency and coming-to-be decisions as 1:3. Literal target wording can sound bodily or possessive; do not infer physical hands. Alternatives are idiomatic through him / al yado.

alignments.el_proposed: και ο κόσμος δεν τον γνώρισε
alignments.note: Knew versus recognized/acknowledged remains a contextual choice. Greek masculine ton links a personal referent; light is grammatically neuter in Greek, so reference must not be inferred solely from translated gender.

el.text: Ήρθε σε όσα ήταν δικά του, και οι δικοί του δεν τον δέχτηκαν.

he.text: אל אשר לו בא ואשר לו לא קבלוהו׃

alignments.el_proposed: Ήρθε σε όσα ήταν δικά του
alignments.note: Possessive expression without an explicit noun. Greek supplies a neuter-plural nominalization; Hebrew retains ellipsis. Home/domain/possessions are interpretive alternatives, not named places in the source.

alignments.el_proposed: και οι δικοί του δεν τον δέχτηκαν
alignments.note: Plural receiving verb informs the proposal his own people. Do not insert a specific nation, ethnic group, household or place. Hebrew qbl is a deliberately source-near stylistic choice requiring target-register review.
